svg.title: Trim-inclusive bandgap: dummy devices — sheet 2 of 2
svg.desc: All 13 netlisted dummy banks. 197 PMOS units have drain, gate, source and body tied to AVDD; 64 NMOS units have all four terminals tied to AVSS. Each symbol represents m identical devices. Sizes are per device.
svg.text: 13 banks / 261 units · Same source and nets as sheet 1
PMOS · pfet_05v0 · 197 units · All terminals tied to AVDD
NMOS · nfet_05v0 · 64 units · All terminals tied to AVSS
m is the number of identical physical units; W and L are per-unit dimensions.
The four-terminal connections are explicit: no dummy gate or diffusion floats.
“Matches” identifies the functional array that the dummy bank surrounds.
The panel arrangement is for readability; it does not depict physical placement.
Graphical companion to LAYOUT_MATCHING_DUMMIES in Bandgap_Core_Res.sch; verified against the released netlist.
